title: 'Tongari Boushi no Atelier' Second Season Announced
content: The official website for the Tongari Boushi no Atelier ( Witch Hat Atelier ) television anime announced on Tuesday that a second season is in production. Produced by BUG FILMS , the first season adapting Kamome Shirahama 's fantasy manga premiered with the first two episodes on Tokyo MX and BS11 on April 6.
